git_rationale.why_issue_occurred: Initial config designed as quick CNY->EUR scalar. Agent prompts inherited USD from LLM defaults. No central currency_local authority existed.
git_rationale.how_fix_addresses_root: Replaced entire currency model: single exchange_rates map, plan-level currency_local authority, unified agent instructions, simplified conversion formula, validation enforcement.

diff_stats.justification_for_overage: 10-task architecture redesign spanning config, 8 agent prompts, 2 data files, 3 scripts, 2 schemas. New validation functions (currency consistency + save guard) require new code. Data file edits are mechanical multiplications.
